subject: general
question: If LCM and HCF of two numbers are 70 and 7 respectively and if one number is 35, then what will be the second number?
solution:
Given:

LCM and HCF of two numbers are 70 and 7 respectively 

One of the numbers is 35

Concept used:

LCM × HCF = The Product of two numbers

Calculation:

The second number = {{70 × 7} over 35} = 14

∴ The second number will be 14.
